frozen_source_manifest.method: Read each of the 45 recorded paths from git show at the frozen SHA and compare SHA-256 with source-freeze.json

performance_source_binding.method: Read benchmark script and raw baseline/candidate/comparison records; compare all four candidate source hashes with current frozen source files
performance_source_binding.scope: 36 synthetic observations, three unprofiled timing samples plus three profiling runs per phase; local comparator overhead only
performance_source_binding.limitation: Both raw head fields record the base commit because the candidate was measured in a modified worktree; candidate source hashes provide the later binding. No model, Token, cost, native host or hardware effect is inferred.

questioning_observations.method: Read both saved isolated-conversation observations and their capture/version limitations
questioning_observations.partial_answer_version: Earlier pre-compression wording; not treated as exact-final-Skill execution evidence
questioning_observations.revision_dependency_version: Observer reports complete text equality with the final Skill; hash was captured later, not during the scenario
questioning_observations.limitation: Supplementary qualitative observations only; no controlled model A/B, native host qualification or Token measurement.

limitations: Full regression, archive evidence, final reviewer binding, remote CI, merge and release have not been observed for this frozen source in this phase.

Earlier intermediate review independently ran 103 routing/task/effect tests and four additional invalid-time cases; those runs predate this source freeze and are not claimed as exact-SHA final evidence.
Acceptance composition compares names, not grader implementation semantics; timestamps and identity remain caller observations.
BSP fixture verifies command arguments and failure handling, not a real cross-compiled firmware or hardware result.
No external model invocation or real model A/B, Token/cost or native runtime qualification was performed.
Bounded lexical negation does not claim complete natural-language or double-negation understanding.
